SCI School's Education at Doctoral level
Welcome to the support pages for doctoral students and staff at the SCI School. The internal pages about education at doctoral level are intended for doctoral students, supervisors, and other staff involved in doctoral education.
Doctoral Support
Here, you will find most of what you need during your doctoral studies.
Support pages for those working with doctoral education
(Supervisors, Administrative staff, Faculty Administrators, Research and Development Officers, etc.)
SCI PhD Student Council
Hej and welcome to the homepage of the SCI PhD Student Council.
On these pages you can find information about student representation at SCI as well as some general information & tips, from student to student.
Visit the SCI PhD Student Council
